english.note: Use this for someone or something excessively tender, emotionally delicate, or prone to melancholy rather than merely emotion-based.

examples.english: They have always been sentimental; even an old song makes them think of many past events.
examples.traditional: 佢一向多愁善感，聽到一首舊歌都會諗起好多往事。
